name: Ayashiro Suzune
source:
A second-year student at Meirin Academy, she is the daughter of the Ayashiro Dojo. She has a calm and collected personality. She rarely gets emotional, and is known by those around her as a cool girl.

She aims to excel in both academics and sports, and excels in both studies and sports. She lost her mother to illness when she was young, and lives with her father.
In her young mind, she has been actively doing all the housework since she was a child, so as not to cause trouble for her father. As a result, she is able to do most housework without any problems.

Although she doesn't remember much, she admires her mother, who is kind and gentle, as told to her by her father. She has been trained by her father since she was a child, and is skilled enough to serve as a teacher. She is skilled enough to subdue men if their physiques are not too different.
People around her expect her to be a successful martial artist, but she has no intention of
 pursuing that path.
If anything, she has seen many people injured in martial arts since she was a child, so she wants to work in a job that helps people, such as a doctor or nurse.

Her favorite thing is stuffed animals that are big enough to hold in both hands.
